Valentine’s Day 2024 is a week-long event during which Snorlax’s requested dishes will be set to “Desserts/Drinks,” and the final Strength value for dishes will be multiplied by 1.5 . Note: The multiplier for Extra Tasty dishes will be different depending on the day. On Sunday, Extra Tasty dishes will give 4.5 times as much Strength , and on the other days, it will give 3 times as much . Also, you’ll be able to meet Pokémon of various sleep types regardless of your own. In particular, Bulbasaur, Jigglypuff, Slowpoke, Pinsir, Chikorita, and Absol —all Pokémon that gather ingredients perfect for Valentine’s Day—will be more likely to appear . You may even meet a Shiny Bulbasaur, Jigglypuff, Slowpoke, Pinsir, Chikorita, or Absol! Through limited-time missions during the event, you can get great rewards such as 10 Poké Biscuits . And to commemorate this event, two new Dessert/Drink recipes will be added! Try various combinations of ingredients to discover these new recipes! We hope you’re looking forward to it! Event period Day 1: Monday, February 12 at 4:00 a.m. to Tuesday, February 13 at 3:59 a.m. Day 2: Tuesday, February 13 at 4:00 a.m. to Wednesday, February 14 at 3:59 a.m. Day 3: Wednesday, February 14 at 4:00 a.m. to Thursday, February 15 at 3:59 a.m. Day 4: Thursday, February 15 at 4:00 a.m. to Friday, February 16 at 3:59 a.m. Day 5: Friday, February 16 at 4:00 a.m. to Saturday, February 17 at 3:59 a.m. Day 6: Saturday, February 17 at 4:00 a.m. to Sunday, February 18 at 3:59 a.m. Day 7: Sunday, February 18 at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, February 19 at 3:59 a.m. How to Progress in the Event Participating in the event is easy! Simply press the “Sleep” button before going to sleep during the event period to track your sleep. A variety of event-related effects will be triggered during your sleep research. Note: Event bonuses can be triggered in any area during this event.
